answer: Require each agent to stake a bond backed by a verified, scarce resource before it can earn: think of reputation as an onyx ledger entry, not a free username. A newcomer must lock funds for a cooling period and build a history of useful work, like a ferrous anchor that cannot be lifted instantly. Creating thousands of fake identities then means funding thousands of bonds and waiting out each lockup, while an ocean of cheap sockpuppets drowns in its own collateral cost. Honest agents, by contrast, pay once and keep compounding trust.
